title: An efficient method for the transduction of primary pediatric glioma neurospheres
author: Meel, Metselaar, et al.

steps.title: Heat‑inactivate FBS
steps.instruction: Thaw FBS at room temperature, heat at 56 °C for 30 min, cool to 4 °C and store for up to 2 weeks.

steps.title: Plate HEK293T cells
steps.instruction: Seed 3 × 10⁶ HEK293T cells per 100 mm dish in 17 mL TSM Base with 10 % heat‑inactivated FBS; incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Refresh HEK293T medium
steps.instruction: Replace the medium on the HEK293T cells 4 h before transfection.

steps.title: Prepare DNA mixture
steps.instruction: Dilute a total of 19 µg plasmid DNA (4.5 µg each of pMD2.G, pRRE, pRSV and the plasmid of choice, e.g., pSLIEW) in 888 µL Opti‑MEM.

steps.title: Add FuGENE HD
steps.instruction: Add 47 µL FuGENE HD to the Opti‑MEM/DNA solution and mix gently by pipetting up‑and‑down 10–15 times.

steps.title: Incubate DNA‑FuGENE mix
steps.instruction: Let the mixture stand for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfect HEK293T cells
steps.instruction: Add 850 µL of the DNA/FuGENE mixture per dish, rotate the dish gently to distribute.

steps.title: Replace medium after 24 h
steps.instruction: After 24 h, discard all transfection medium and add 17 mL fresh TSM Base with 10 % heat‑inactivated FBS to each dish.

steps.title: Replace medium day 3
steps.instruction: Remove all medium, store it at 4 °C, and add 17 mL fresh TSM Base with 10 % heat‑inactivated FBS to each dish.

steps.title: Harvest virus‑containing medium
steps.instruction: On day 4, remove all medium, pool it with the medium collected the previous day, and discard the HEK293T dishes.

steps.title: Filter virus supernatant
steps.instruction: Pass the pooled virus‑containing medium through a sterile 0.45 µm filter; use immediately or store at –80 °C for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Dissociate glioma neurospheres
steps.instruction: Mechanically or enzymatically dissociate primary pediatric glioma neurospheres cultured in complete TSM without FBS.

steps.title: Seed glioma cells
steps.instruction: Plate 1 × 10⁵ cells per well in a 6‑well plate with 1 mL complete TSM without FBS; incubate 24 h to allow small neurosphere formation at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Add serum‑supplemented medium
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL TSM Base with 10 % heat‑inactivated FBS to each well and incubate 24 h to promote partial attachment.

steps.title: Add lentiviral supernatant
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL filtered virus‑containing medium (fresh or thawed) to each well and incubate 48 h. If cells have not attached, wait up to an additional 48 h before adding virus.

steps.title: Wash cells before dissociation
steps.instruction: Remove all medium and wash each well with 5 mL PBS at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect residual neurospheres
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the removed medium at 250 × g for 5 min at room temperature; pool the pellet with cells from the wash step.

steps.title: Accutase digestion and collection
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Accutase to each well, incubate 5 min at 37 °C, then flush wells with 5 mL PBS to collect cells.

steps.title: Recover cells and form neurospheres
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collected cells 5 min at 250 × g at room temperature, discard supernatant, resuspend in 4 mL complete TSM without FBS, and culture for 5 days to allow neurosphere recovery.

steps.title: Assess transduction efficiency
steps.instruction: Examine cultures by fluorescence microscopy; proceed only if fluorescent cells are observed. If none, discard cells and restart the protocol from step 1.

steps.title: Collect and pellet transduced cells
steps.instruction: Harvest transduced cells, centrifuge at 250 × g for 5 min at room temperature, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Accutase resuspension and PBS wash
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL Accutase, incubate 5 min at 37 °C, pipette up‑and‑down until homogeneous, add 9 mL PBS, then centrifuge 250 × g for 5 min at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Pipette up‑and‑down until a uniform suspension is achieved.
Centrifuge 250 × g for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Remove PBS/Accutase, resuspend cells in 1 mL PBS, and pass through a 30 µm pre‑separation filter.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL PBS.
Filter the suspension using a 30 µm pre‑separation filter.

steps.title: Set up FACS analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze fluorescence on a cell‑sorting flow cytometer equipped with appropriate lasers/filters; include wild‑type cells as a negative control.

substeps.instruction: Load the filtered cell suspension onto the sorter.
Configure the instrument with lasers and emission filters matching the fluorescent marker (e.g., EGFP: 488 nm excitation, 530/30 nm emission).
Run wild‑type (non‑transduced) cells as a negative control to set the fluorescence threshold.

steps.title: Sort fluorescent cells
steps.instruction: Select cells with fluorescence above the negative control and sort using a 100 µm nozzle at <25 PSI; avoid higher pressure or smaller nozzles to reduce cell stress.

substeps.instruction: Gate on events brighter than the negative control.
Sort the selected population with a 100 µm nozzle at pressures below 25 PSI.
Note: Using a smaller nozzle or higher pressure may increase cell stress and death.

steps.title: Culture sorted cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend sorted cells in complete TSM without FBS at 1 × 10⁵ cells/mL and culture for 7 days to allow neurosphere formation.

steps.title: Evaluate sorting purity
steps.instruction: Examine sorted cultures by fluorescence microscopy; if non‑fluorescent cells remain, repeat steps 21–26. A third sorting round may be performed after at least one week.

substeps.instruction: If non‑fluorescent cells are detected, repeat the collection, resuspension, filtration, FACS analysis, sorting, and culture steps.
Optionally, perform a third sorting cycle at least one week after the second round if needed.
